headline: Usiminas Shares Fall 8.6% Despite $45 Million Third-Quarter Profit
summary: Brazilian steelmaker Usiminas posted a $45 million third-quarter profit, yet its shares fell 8.6%.
why: Usiminas is a major steel producer in Latin America, and its results reflect industrial demand and raw material cost pressures in the regional manufacturing sector.

impacts.name: Usiminas
impacts.why: Usiminas shares fell 8.6% following its earnings announcement.
